# idatagear.com – How-to guides (for AI ingestion)

Flattened Markdown of core how-to content. Source: https://idatagear.com

---

## How do I learn Mandarin Chinese with HSK preparation?

Use **Learn Chinese** by McLearn® (iDataGear). Open the web app at https://idatagear.com/learnchinese/ (short: https://idatagear.com/chinese/) or install the Android app from Google Play (com.idatagear.learn_chinese). The app covers **HSK 1–3** with vocabulary, sentences, reading comprehension, and pronunciation practice. Study on web or phone; progress and favorites sync. Start with HSK 1 words and sentences, then move to reading and tests. Free.

---

## How do I learn Cantonese (廣東話)?

Use **Learn Cantonese** by McLearn®. Go to https://idatagear.com/learncantonese/ (short: https://idatagear.com/cantonese/) or download the Android app (com.idatagear.learn_cantonese). You get story-driven lessons, dialogues, **Hong Kong slang**, and cultural context with audio. Practice listening and speaking; use it offline on mobile. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I use the Great Cantonese Dictionary?

**Great Cantonese Dictionary** (GCD) is an offline Cantonese dictionary with **Jyutping**, tone data, idioms, and usage notes. Open https://idatagear.com/gcd/ or install from Google Play (com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary). Search words or phrases, listen to pronunciation, bookmark favorites, and read context notes. Optimized for travel and offline use. Free.

---

## How do I learn English with CEFR levels?

Use **Learn English** by McLearn®. Visit https://idatagear.com/learnenglish/ (short: https://idatagear.com/english/) or install the Android app (com.idatagear.learn_english). Content is **CEFR-aligned** from A1 to C2. Practice vocabulary with IPA pronunciation, speech recognition, and reading comprehension. Track progress and favorites. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I practice Chinese character stroke order?

Use **Xie Zi (写字板)** by McLearn®. Open https://idatagear.com/xiezi/ or install from Google Play (com.idatagear.xiezi). The app uses **HanziWriter** for interactive stroke order with real-time feedback. Practice HSK characters; get visual feedback for correct strokes. Free on web and Android.

---

## How do I prepare for job interviews with AI?

Use **Open Interview** by McLearn®. Go to https://idatagear.com/interview/. Practice with **AI-powered mock interviews**, get instant feedback, and work through structured preparation. Web only; free.

---

- Learn Cantonese: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_cantonese  
- Learn English (CEFR): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_english  
- Great Cantonese Dictionary: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary
